scenarios.expectation: the audit stream writes no line at all
scenarios.injection: the main store file is read only, so the generation can not be committed
scenarios.invariant: the audit stream never describes a generation that was not committed

scenarios.note: the injection keeps the generation from being written: in this fixture the upstream precondition stops the pass and the main store is read only on top of that.  The commit phase itself is covered by the source order guard, which proves that the publish call sits behind the successful commit
